{{Top|leg}}
An '''autotourniquet''' was a device used in medical procedures that sealed over wounds and amputations to restrict blood loss. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had an autotourniquet as part of its emergency medical supplies. This autotourniquet was used when the ''Falcon'' rescued [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had lost his right hand in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
